summary.name: Interviews by AI
summary.one_liner: An AI interview practice tool that generates role-specific questions from a job description, lets you answer out loud or in writing, and scores your answer with feedback and a rewritten sample.
use_cases: Preparing for a job interview for a specific role
Practicing behavioral questions using the STAR method
Rebuilding past work into interview stories after a career switch
Getting early-career candidates ready for interviews
Rehearsing answers out loud with a timer
summary.what_it_does: The tool generates interview questions from a pasted job description, a bank of common interview questions, or questions the user brings. Users answer by speaking into a mic or typing, with a timer to keep pace. After each answer it gives a score across structure, specificity, delivery and filler words, plus notes on what was clear or vague and a rewritten sample response. The page says it can use an uploaded resume to point to relevant experiences, and saved sessions are kept in a dashboard.
notable: Generates role-specific questions from any pasted job description
Scores answers on structure, specificity, delivery and filler words, with STAR-based feedback
Provides a rewritten sample answer built from the user's own facts
Saves interview history in a dashboard
caveats: Free plan is limited to 3 questions a month; Pro is $9/month for unlimited questions and resume upload
